name: Hajal City
description: A global financial center, it hosts the Bank of Hajal’s main office. The city’s cold climate and seasonal gardens complement its elegant, multicultural design, reflecting its Soulborn founders’ culture. Residents adhere to strict social hierarchies and etiquette, and even the least affluent earn above-average wages, but attire varies by class. The wealthy don formal outfits and fine jewelry, traveling in lavish carriages. The middle class wears long coats and leather boots for style and warmth. Lower-class citizens use work-specific attire, usually marked by employer-specific pins or buttons. Employment is a badge of honor, symbolized by well-kept clothing, while the jobless wear rugged outfits. Though Imperial Law and the Ironhands are present, the Bank essentially rules Hajal because of an old deal with Emperor Baleroth. Attracting visitors from across Tanares, Hajal is a hub for those seeking wealth or investment. However, predatory contracts, idea theft, and even blackmail are rampant here. Rumors of debt-induced servitude hint at the city’s darker aspects. The many wealthy individuals in the city make it ripe for adventurers looking for powerful patrons. Bank investors are always looking for competent individuals to protect their investments in distant lands or to enforce contracts on those unwilling to keep their part. Recently, the Third Eye has been infiltrating the city, slowly building up power to place agents in the higher positions of the Bank. While the Council of Investors of the Bank has received notice of strange movements in the city, they are imprecise. The Councilors are offering high payments to lure great investigators, adventurers, and spies to uncover what is happening in their city.
